visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up shot of pinkish-red raw pork ribs placed in a pink-rimmed pot filled with cold water on a black stovetop. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame against a neutral kitchen background. (2) A medium shot reveals the main character, a female chef with short black hair and glasses, wearing a green apron over a white shirt. She uses metal tongs to transfer blanched ribs into a separate stainless steel bowl of water, while steam rises from the boiling pot. (3) The camera focuses on the chef's hands as she meticulously scrubs the blanched pork ribs in a bowl of water to remove impurities. The lighting is bright and professional, highlighting the texture of the meat. (4) Transitioning to food preparation, the chef slices fresh ginger and a whole apple on a yellow cutting board. She uses a peeler to remove the apple skin and a sharp knife to core and wedge the fruit. (5) The chef places the cleaned ribs and ginger slices into a white ceramic Dutch oven, then pours in clear water from a pitcher, followed by sake, salt, and peppercorns. (6) As the soup begins to simmer, she adds the apple wedges and red dates into the pot. A male figure is briefly visible in the background sitting at a table. (7) Wearing protective plastic gloves, the chef peels a large, long yam over a metal bowl and then cuts it into thick white chunks on the cutting board. (8) The chef tastes the clear broth with a spoon, adjusts the seasoning with salt, and adds the yam pieces. Finally, she garnishes a served bowl of the soup with chopped cilantro before tasting a piece of the tender pork rib and smiling at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 哈囉大家好 我是塔塔. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天來做一道非常簡單又好喝的. (3) [Subtitle]: 山藥蘋果排骨湯. (4) [Subtitle]: 排骨按造慣例 先汆燙. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後清洗一下. (6) [Subtitle]: 接著用飲用水泡一下. (7) [Subtitle]: 切幾片薑片. (8) [Subtitle]: 把排骨放到鍋子裡. (9) [Subtitle]: 薑片放進來. (10) [Subtitle]: 加入1400ml冷水. (11) [Subtitle]: 100ml清酒*(或水). (12) [Subtitle]: 一小撮胡椒粒 一搓鹽調味. (13) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. (14) [Subtitle]: 一旁來準備削蘋果. (15) [Subtitle]: 去掉蒂跟果核. (16) [Subtitle]: 今天的蘋果比較大顆 其實不用這麼多 適量就好. (17) [Subtitle]: 現在湯差不多滾了 把蘋果放進來. (18) [Subtitle]: 一邊煮一邊來幫紅棗去果核. (19) [Subtitle]: 轉小火蓋上鍋蓋 燉煮40~50分鐘. (20) [Subtitle]: 建議山藥削皮的時候 可以戴手套 避免過敏. (21) [Subtitle]: 吃多少削多少 切成大塊狀. (22) [Subtitle]: 最後再切一點香菜提味. (23) [Subtitle]: 喔~湯煮好了 好香喔~. (24) [Subtitle]: 試喝一下 調整鹹味. (25) [Subtitle]: 山藥放進來. (26) [Subtitle]: 我喜歡山藥保留脆脆的口感 大概煮5~10分鐘. (27) [Subtitle]: 像這樣~ 超級好喝又養生的山藥蘋果燉排骨就完成啦~. (28) [Subtitle]: 哇~這湯也太甜了吧. (29) [Subtitle]: 山藥好吃! 排骨也恰到好處!. (30) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書 蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.
